root_cause: attrs.converters.optional() wraps a Converter returned by pipe(str, int) in a plain single-argument closure. The generated __init__ therefore calls optional_converter(value), and optional_converter calls the inner Converter with only value even though the Converter requires value, instance, and field. This causes a TypeError when Measurement("42") is constructed.

impacted_items.reason: This is the function containing the bug; optional() incorrectly handles a Converter object returned by pipe().
pipe() returns a Converter requiring value, instance, and field, which is incompatible with the current optional() wrapper.
The Converter call requires three arguments, but optional_converter currently supplies only the value.
It correctly wraps the plain optional_converter, but this wrapping exposes the incompatible single-argument call path.
This module re-exports optional from attr.converters, so the namespace is affected when the underlying implementation is fixed.
This is a namespace import with no converter logic of its own.
